After my last edit to src/date.ts at 14:02 I ran npm test at 14:05: 212 passed, 0 failed. npm run typecheck last ran at 13:40, before that edit. I did not run the CLI. git status shows src/date.ts and test/date.test.ts modified and an untracked tmp/debug.log. Can I claim completion?
